title: TEMPORA MUTANTUR NOS ET MUTAMUR IN ILLIS
html_source:
Via Google Translate, this goes to

Times change and we change with them

This version seems to be the correct, and is very reflective of the Dedalus family’s position—losing their home, etc.

anchor.text: TEMPORA MUTANTUR NOS ET MUTAMUR IN ILLIS
